edu.what_is.title: Wetin be Jaundice (Yellow Eye/Body)?
edu.what_is.body: Jaundice dey happen when one thing wey dem dey call bilirubin plenty too much for baby blood. E dey make the white part of baby eye, gums, skin, palm, or under foot yellow or brown.
edu.check.title: How to check your baby fine
edu.check.1: Look the white part of baby eye inside light.
edu.check.2: Pull baby lip up small make you look im gums.
edu.check.3: Look im palm and under im foot clear clear.
edu.check.4: Watch how baby dey suck breast and if im sharp when im wake up.
edu.dark_skin.title: How to see Jaundice for Black/Dark Skin Baby
edu.dark_skin.body: Jaundice fit hard to see for black baby skin. No just look the skin body. Check the white of the eye, inside the lips/gums, the palm, and under the foot. Watch if baby dey wake up well and if im dey suck breast fine.
edu.what_to_do.title: Wetin parents suppose do
edu.what_to_do.1: Dey give baby breast milk regular without stopping.
edu.what_to_do.2: Look baby body close-close for the first few days after dem born am.
edu.what_to_do.3: Use this JaundiCare app check anytime your mind no touch ground.
edu.what_to_do.4: Go hospital that same day if you see any danger sign.
edu.what_not_to_do.title: Wetin you NO suppose do
edu.what_not_to_do.1: No look eye say baby no dey suck breast or say im dey sleep too much.
edu.what_not_to_do.2: No waste time to go hospital if you dey look baby layout somehow.
edu.what_not_to_do.3: No go drop baby for direct hot sun say you dey treat jaundice by yourself.
edu.what_not_to_do.4: No assume say all jaundice na play-play thing.
edu.urgent.title: When you must run go hospital right now
edu.urgent.1: Yellow color show inside the first 24 hours wey dem born baby
edu.urgent.2: Baby dey too hard to wake up from sleep
edu.urgent.3: Baby no dey suck breast well or im refuse to suck
edu.urgent.4: Baby body weak flat like rag (no power for body)
edu.urgent.5: Dark urine or white chalky poo-poo
care.feeding.title: Help for breastfeeding matter
care.feeding.body: Breast milk wey plenty dey help baby body flush out the bilirubin through poo-poo and urine.
care.feeding.1: Give baby breast milk many times inside day and night
care.feeding.2: Check if baby catch the breast well when im want suck
care.feeding.3: Call health worker if baby wake up but im no want suck breast
care.mother.title: Wetin Mama fit do
care.mother.1: Dey check baby eye and body every time you dey give am breast
care.mother.2: Look baby eye and mouth inside better light
care.mother.3: Ask health workers question if anything dey worry your mind
care.mother.4: Go all the hospital check-up appointments after delivery
care.maternal.title: Mama care after delivery
care.maternal.body: Mamas too need beta care make their body fit heal fine. Our target na to reduce how long people dey stay for hospital by catching any sickness early and giving treatment sharp-sharp.
care.nutrition.title: Better food layout for mamas
care.nutrition.1: Dey drink plenty water every time
care.nutrition.2: Eat beta food wey get vitamins and vitamins structure
care.nutrition.3: No skip food at all as you dey give baby breast so
care.nutrition.4: Sleep when baby dey sleep, and tell people to help you if body don tire

chw.intro: Community Health Worker (CHW) guidelines to check newborn baby for jaundice, do follow-up look, teach mamas, and clear road for fast hospital referral.

chw.followup.title: Postnatal follow-up timeline
chw.followup.day1: Day 1: Check breastfeeding, alertness, urine, and poo-poo color.
chw.followup.day2: Day 2–3: Check eye white, gums, palm, and sole for yellow style.
chw.followup.day7: Day 7: Recheck feeding, weight fears, and if jaundice still dey.
chw.followup.day14: Day 14: Send baby go general hospital quick if jaundice never clear or e dey worst.
chw.referral.title: How dem dey tura person go hospital (Referral Pathway)
chw.risk.title: Top high-risk things CHW must watch out for
chw.risk.1: Jaundice show face inside the first 24 hours of life.
chw.risk.2: Bad breastfeeding join with yellow color or deep sleep.
chw.risk.3: Weak body, hard to wake, tea-colored urine, or chalk-white poo.
chw.risk.4: Black babies—because yellow color dey hard to show quick on dark skin.
chw.alignment.title: Community newborn care structure
chw.alignment.body: This layout dey built for parents and community health workers to catch jaundice early, track am step-by-step, and send baby to higher hospital fast if e need special care.

voice.text: Play the automatic voice guide about newborn jaundice to teach parents.
voice.unsupported: Your device no support web voice play system.
voice.script: Jaundice for newborn baby fit turn to big problem if dem no find am early. Biko look baby eye white part, inside the lip or gums, the palm, and under the foot if e yellow or brown. Watch how baby dey suck breast, if im alert, and check im urine and poo-poo color. If baby hard to wake up, im body weak, im refuse breast, or im catch yellow color inside the first 24 hours wey dem born am, carry baby run go hospital today-today make dem help you.
